name: shifra-nuha-technologies
description: Marketing website for Shifra Nuha Technologies - business registration, tax, accounting and professional services for businesses across Kerala.

scripts.test:smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/smoke.tsx --outDir node_modules/.tmp/ssr --logLevel error && node node_modules/.tmp/ssr/smoke.js
scripts.test:a11y: vite build --ssr scripts/a11y-check.tsx --outDir node_modules/.tmp/ssr --logLevel error && node node_modules/.tmp/ssr/a11y-check.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:a11y
